name: engineering-writing
description: Adaptable writing guidance for engineering documentation, change summaries, and work messages.

interface.longDescription: Draft and revise engineering communication with clear reader context, explicit causal steps, and claims grounded in evidence. Adapt the defaults to your audience, voice, and project conventions.
defaultPrompt: Revise this technical explanation for an engineer new to the project.
Draft a PR description from these changes and validation results.
Make this engineering update clearer while preserving my voice and the facts.
